report.summary: Four high-severity items: trace_id default contradiction, budget overshoot in graph_brief, quarantine tasks excluded from reports, unverifiable shared walk in render. One medium: token ratio misleading flag not surfaced.
risks: trace_id default contradiction is a breaking change for any caller omitting trace_id
Budget overshoot in graph_brief could silently truncate context that ollama cannot repair
Quarantine tasks excluded from reports could cause underestimation of architecture coverage
Unverifiable shared walk may indicate missing data pipeline between engines
Token ratio misleading if callers ignore exact flag
todos: Add default for trace_id in Intent dataclass
Inspect graph_brief._emit to ensure header cost is included in budget check
Ensure analyse_once in render.py includes quarantine tasks in reports
Verify the shared walk pipeline exists and is wired correctly
Surface the exact flag from _whole_repo_tokens and semantic_slice to all callers

items.title: Fix Intent.trace_id default contradiction
items.why_now: Breaking change: any caller omitting trace_id will get TypeError. This is a kernel-level defect in a core schema.

steps.do: Add `trace_id: str = ''` to the Intent dataclass definition in daedalus/spine/ledger.py
steps.verified_by: Run `python -c "from daedalus.spine.ledger import Intent; i = Intent(); assert i.trace_id == ''"`

items.assumption: The empty string is an acceptable default; if not, adjust to a sentinel or factory call.

items.title: Fix budget overshoot in graph_brief._emit
items.why_now: If header cost is added after line fit check, the token budget may be exceeded, causing truncation that ollama cannot repair.

steps.do: Inspect daedalus/lanes/graph_brief.py lines 283-294; if header cost is not included before deciding to add a line, include it in the budget check.
steps.verified_by: Write a unit test that passes a large header and verifies the budget is not exceeded.

items.assumption: The actual _emit implementation is in the indicated lines; if not, adjust the search.

items.title: Ensure analyse_once includes quarantine tasks in reports
items.why_now: Quarantine tasks are excluded from healthy tasks in harness.py; if analyse_once uses by_provenance results, quarantine tasks will be missing from reach/switch reports even though they are counted.

steps.do: Inspect daedalus/mapping/render.py to see how analyse_once uses evaluation aggregates. grep -n 'by_provenance\|go/no-go\|quarantine' daedalus/mapping/render.py
steps.verified_by: Command output shows the usage (or absence) of by_provenance and quarantine.

steps.do: If analyse_once uses by_provenance, modify it to also include quarantine tasks, or document the exclusion.
steps.verified_by: Run the mapping CLI on a repo with quarantine tasks and verify they appear in the output.

items.assumption: analyse_once is defined in render.py and uses by_provenance; if not, adjust the grep.

items.title: Verify the shared walk pipeline exists in render.py
items.why_now: The docstring describes a shared data pipeline between reach and switches engines, but the provided code chunks do not show it.

steps.verified_by: Command output shows where analyse_once is defined and called.

steps.do: If analyse_once does not exist, create it or document the current data flow.
steps.verified_by: Run the mapping CLI and verify that both reach and switch reports are generated consistently.

items.assumption: analyse_once is the function that implements the shared walk; if not, adjust the search.

items.title: Surface the exact flag from token estimation to all callers
items.why_now: If callers ignore the exact flag, the reduction ratio may be systematically flattering when tiktoken is absent.

steps.do: Check all callers of _whole_repo_tokens and semantic_slice in daedalus/structcore/slice.py and daedalus/eval/harness.py to see if they surface the exact flag.
steps.verified_by: grep -rn '_whole_repo_tokens\|semantic_slice' daedalus/ and inspect each caller.

steps.do: For any caller that does not surface the flag, add it to the return value or log a warning.
steps.verified_by: Run a test where tiktoken is absent and verify the flag is surfaced.

items.assumption: The exact flag is defined in _whole_repo_tokens and semantic_slice; if not, adjust the search.
